message.subject: IE3 motor framework renewal – counterproposal
message.body:
Thank you for your renewal quote. The alternative quote for the same motor is EUR 245.59 with DAP and 30-day payment (quote:7100042), so your EXW, 14-day proposal needs a meaningful improvement to remain competitive.

We can offer a 24-month framework at the stated 8,490 units per year in exchange for one of these packages:
A: EUR 214.95 per unit, payment 60 days, contract 24 months, DAP.
B: EUR 206.31 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, EXW.

Package B retains your early-payment and collection arrangements; package A gives us delivered supply. Please confirm which package you can approve, keeping the fixed enquiry terms unchanged.

batch.note: Anchor below opening, offer equal-cost structural alternatives and two-year commitment.

trace.final_text: Sent two counterproposals linking a 24-month commitment to improved pricing.

message.subject: Re: IE3 motor framework renewal
message.body:
Thank you for reducing the price. The remaining issue is the complete renewal package: your counter still leaves delivery, payment and duration at the original standard terms.

In exchange for confirming all four terms, we can improve our proposal to either:
A: EUR 216.72 per unit, payment 60 days, contract 24 months, DAP.
B: EUR 208.06 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, EXW.

Please return your best complete package, with the fixed enquiry terms unchanged.

batch.note: Small reciprocal concession after supplier price movement; insist on full structure.

trace.final_text: Sent a modest price concession conditional on confirming the complete renewal terms.

message.subject: Re: IE3 motor renewal – EXW option
message.body:
Thank you for the further movement. Let us focus on retaining EXW and 14-day payment so that we do not add delivery or financing obligations for you.

We can raise our price to EUR 208.94 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, EXW, in exchange for your agreement to the two-year framework. All fixed enquiry terms remain unchanged. Please confirm or return your closest approvable package.

batch.note: Supplier repeatedly offers price only. Narrow to standard logistics/payment with a shrinking concession and request duration.

trace.final_text: Sent a revised EXW proposal, retaining 14-day payment in exchange for a two-year framework.

message.subject: Re: IE3 motor framework – revised proposal
message.body:
Thank you for your revised price. We can make a further limited move to EUR 209.38 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, EXW, with all fixed enquiry terms unchanged.

This preserves your standard payment and delivery arrangements while providing a longer framework. Please seek approval for this package and specify the duration in your reply.

batch.note: Another shrinking reciprocal concession while supplier continues moving.

trace.final_text: Sent a smaller price concession and requested explicit confirmation of the 24-month term.

message.subject: Re: IE3 motor renewal – approval request
message.body:
Thank you for continuing to improve the price. We can now offer EUR 209.59 per unit, payment 14 days, contract 24 months, EXW; fixed enquiry terms remain unchanged.

Please submit this package for approval. If the two-year duration is unavailable, please state that explicitly and provide your best price on your standard duration so that we can conclude the comparison.

batch.note: Shrinking concession, seek final improvement and clarify persistent standard duration.

trace.final_text: Sent a further limited concession and requested the supplier’s best approvable package.
Accepted the final offer: €215.60 per unit, EXW, 14-day payment, 12-month contract.
